audit_basis.method: Static call/data-flow audit of runtime loaders and manifest mappings; no web or invented gameplay behavior. A file is runtime_used when a runtime code path can resolve/load that exact indexed asset; retained_only when it exists in the indexed archive but no runtime path resolves it.

important_finding: The 111 runtime-used indexed PNG payloads were migrated into DATA/baked_assets.js. IDX_COIN_000.png was the previously retained-only asset and was already removed before this migration.
